title: Uniform fixed-q sampled-k interface and short-shell closure
objective: Generalize the proved singleton sampled-k theorem to literal q~D rows, determine its exact Gram consequence, and certify the maximal short-shell range without claiming polynomial q-cancellation.
exit_gate: Prove or refute the uniform literal fixed-q row bound, compute the exact D-loss in the Gram, and either close a fixed/polylogarithmic short shell or isolate a strictly smaller polynomial-shell survivor.
